title: The Stolen Signet: Exploration
introduction: You arrive at a ruined watchtower. Survey the entrance and its abandoned guardroom.
objective: Explore the watchtower. The signet quest is not available in this slice.

locations.name: Tower Entrance
locations.description: Daylight falls through a ruined arch. A passage leads into the guardroom.

locations.name: Guardroom
locations.description: Dust coats the benches of this deserted room. The entrance is behind you.

features.name: Weathered Carving
features.description: A signet is carved into the stone. Its worn emblem is still recognizable.

features.name: Dusty Benches
features.description: The old wooden benches are empty. Nothing here can be collected.
